occurrences.reason: Repeating look-alike tiles (image, title, CTA, description) in a wrapping grid.

usage: Grid of offer/tour tiles. One row per card: image cell (an image, or a Dynamic Media composite image URL), body cell with a title paragraph, a CTA link paragraph, and a description paragraph.
reuseGuidance: Use for product/tour/offer tiles that each carry a title, CTA button and short description. For image-plus-caption tiles use cards-caption.
